program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (sep (find-first (lambda (c)
                                   (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c) 4)))
                                 (range 0 w))))
           (build-grid h
                       sep
                       (r c)
                       (let* ((a (at g r c))
                              (b (at g r (+ sep 1 c))))
                         (if (!= (zero? a) (zero? b)) 2 0))))))
